name: bar-chart

css: #tpl-bar-chart { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; padding: 0 9%; background: #0a0a1a; } #tpl-bar-chart .bc-heading { font-size: 52px; font-weight: 700; color: #ffffff; margin-bottom: 50px; } #tpl-bar-chart .bc-row { display: flex; align-items: center; margin: 18px 0; } #tpl-bar-chart .bc-bar { height: 44px; border-radius: 6px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #6d8bff, #8b6dff); margin-right: 24px; flex: none; min-width: 12%; max-width: 70%; } #tpl-bar-chart .bc-label { font-size: 28px; color: #c8d4ff; }
